subject.title: fix: resolve response prefix template variables in abort replies

question: Should maintainers repair this conflicting PR in place, replace it with a fresh current-main fix, or intentionally accept config-default-only abort prefixes?
rationale: The direct-path bug and screenshot proof are real, but merging this branch as-is leaves routed delivery and active model/session state correctness gaps, and the branch needs a branch-path choice before merge.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Update the branch to pass active prefix context through routed abort delivery, seed from active session/channel model state, rebase on current main, and rerun focused proof.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Fix
options.body: Keep the linked issue canonical and use a new current-main implementation if preserving this stale branch is not worth the conflict and review churn.

options.title: Accept Default-Only Mitigation
options.body: Merge the narrower behavior while explicitly accepting that routed or override sessions can still show raw or stale model/thinking prefix state.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Update the branch to pass active prefix context through routed abort delivery, seed from active session/channel model state, rebase on current main, and rerun focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest recent history across reply-prefix, route delivery, and session/model routing surfaces needed for this branch-path choice.
